template_data.headline_html: Which certs actually move federal dollars.

items.title: SDVOSB
items.desc: VA awarded $3.6B to small businesses in Q2 2026. Set-asides lock out most competitors by design.

items.title: HUBZone
items.desc: 10% price evaluation preference. Real math in competitive bids — not a participation trophy.

items.title: 8(a)
items.desc: Sole-source authority up to $4.5M ($7M for manufacturing). Competing against 5 beats competing against 500.

items.title: WOSB / EDWOSB
items.desc: Real set-asides exist — but only in specific NAICS codes. Most owners assume they qualify and never check.
